description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.

 Job Description 

 Job Title: Business Intelligence Reporting/ Web Developer 
 Locations : Hybrid: Fort Worth, TX | Jacksonville, FL | New York, NY | Sacramento, CA
 
 Get To Know The Team: 
 The BI Reporting & Web Developer is a hybrid technical role within the Unique Assets Development team, responsible for both enterprise reporting and client-facing web development. The developer will design and maintain SSRS reports and Power BI dashboards that surface trust accounting data to internal and external stakeholders, while also contributing to web-based applications and tools that support the team’s broader platform. 
 This role requires strong SQL skills, hands-on SSRS and Power BI experience, and proven web development capability. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between reporting and application development work, communicates well with business stakeholders, and thrives in a regulated financial systems environment. 
 
 What You Will Get To Do: 
 
 BI Report Development & Delivery  
 Design, develop, test, and deploy SSRS reports for internal stakeholders, client-facing statements, and regulatory outputs 
 Build and maintain Power BI dashboards with drill-down, filtering, and KPI visualizations 
 Translate business requirements from BAs, operations, and management into accurate, well-documented reporting solutions 
 Manage SSRS subscriptions, permissions, and scheduled report delivery 
 Ensure report accuracy and consistency with source data and business rules 
 
 Web Development  
 Design and develop web applications and internal tools in support of the Unique Assets platform 
 Build responsive, accessible front-end interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (VueJS, React or Angular preferred) 
 Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and similar platforms) to accelerate web development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance productivity while adhering to established coding standards and security best practices 
 Collaborate with the broader development team on architecture, code reviews, and best practices 
 Apply version control (Git) and participate in SDLC processes including code review and QA 
 
 Data & SQL Development  
 Write complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions to support reporting and application data needs 
 Optimize query performance for large financial and trust accounting datasets 
 Work with data warehouses, OLTP databases, and staging environments to source and shape data 
 Collaborate with DBAs to ensure data quality, integrity, and access patterns are maintained 
 
 Collaboration & Requirements  
 Partner with business analysts, QA, and operations staff through requirements gathering, UAT, and post-deployment validation 
 Engage stakeholders on adjacent legacy systems (e.g. Rocket Universe) to understand source data structure and lineage ahead of SQL replication 
 Document report logic, data sources, API contracts, and field definitions for maintainability 
 Support end-users with report and application questions, training, and ad hoc analysis 
 
 What You Will Bring: 
 3+ years of hands-on SSRS report development in a production environment 
 2+ years of Power BI development) 
 3+ years of SQL Server development with strong T-SQL proficiency 
 2+ years of web application development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and at least one modern front-end framework (VueJS, React or Angular strongly preferred) 
 Experience working in financial services, trust accounting, wealth management, or another regulated industry preferred 
 
 Technical Skills  
 SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) — paginated reports, subscriptions, RDL authoring, Report Builder 
 Power BI — Desktop, Service, DAX, Power Query, dataflows, row-level security 
 T-SQL — stored procedures, CTEs, window functions, query tuning and execution plan analysis 
 Web — HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React or Angular, REST API integration 
 SQL Server — SSMS, profiler, database objects 
 Source control — Git-based workflows, branching, pull requests 
 Data modeling fundamentals (star schema, normalization) 
 
 Preferred Qualifications  
 Experience with trust accounting or financial portfolio management platforms 
 Familiarity with data conversion and ETL processes 
 Familiarity with legacy database platforms such as Rocket Universe (UniData/UniVerse) for source data analysis 
 Experience with server-side web technologies (.NET, Node.js, or similar) 
 Understanding of TDD and automated testing practices in a regulated software environment 
 
 Education: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience 
 
 Core Competencies: 
 Analytical thinking — breaks down complex data problems and translates them into reliable, usable outputs 
 Technical versatility — able to shift effectively between reporting and web development work 
 Attention to detail — ensures accuracy in financial and regulatory reporting contexts 
 Communication — able to convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders 
 Collaboration — works effectively across development, QA, BA, and operations teams 
 Ownership — takes responsibility for quality and timeliness across both reporting and application deliverables 
 Adaptability — thrives in a fast-moving environment with evolving data and business needs 
 
 Why You Will Love It Here! 
 Flexibility : Hybrid Work Model & a Business Casual Dress Code, including jeans
 Your Future: 401k Matching Program, Professional Development Reimbursement
 Work/Life Balance: Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Sick Leave, Paid Holidays
 Your Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave
 Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, including SS&C University
 Extra Perks: Discounts on fitness clubs, travel, and more!
 
 Thank you for your interest in SS&C! To further explore this opportunity, please apply through our careers page on the corporate website at www.ssctech.com/careers .

 Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.
  
  
SS&C Technologies offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and future. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan with company match; paid time off, holidays, and parental leave; and professional development reimbursement opportunity.  
  
Actual base salary will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, prior experience, education, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. 
 
 
 
New York: The expected base salary for the position is between 105,000.00 USD to 135,000.00 USD. California: The expected base salary for the position is between 105,000.00 USD to 135,000.00 USD.  
  
In addition, employees in this role may be eligible for consideration on an annual basis for a discretionary bonus and/or equity awards, such as restricted stock units or stock options, based upon individual and business performance at the company’s discretion.  
  
  
  
 
 Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
